subject: math

hotspots.label: Multiple
hotspots.description: Each multiple is the base number times a whole number — 3, 6, 9, 12 are multiples of 3.
hotspots.positionHint: The numbers the marker lands on along the track.
hotspots.function: The products of a base number and the whole numbers.

hotspots.label: Times-table strip
hotspots.description: The multiplication facts that generate the multiples — 3 × 1 = 3, 3 × 2 = 6, 3 × 3 = 9.
hotspots.positionHint: The flat strip below the track showing each 3 × n fact.
hotspots.function: Shows the multiplication that produces each multiple.

hotspots.label: Common multiple
hotspots.description: A common multiple appears on two different lists — 12 is on both 3's list and 4's list.
hotspots.positionHint: The highlighted plate that glows when a number belongs to both active lists.
hotspots.function: Highlights numbers shared by two multiples lists.

visualStyleNotes: Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A long skip-counting track with a hopping marker, a times-table strip beneath, and a base-number slider. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (molecular-green / grid-blue / amber from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Track: ink-grey strip with warm paper number tiles (roughness ~0.5). Marker: warm amber sphere/arrow (roughness ~0.4). Times-table strip: warm paper with ink text. Slider: soft warm-grey rail with amber knob. Common-multiple highlight: app-driven glow plate on a number tile. No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: multiples as skip counting and times-table results — a track of number tiles with a hopping marker and a base-number slider.

GEOMETRY: Track: a long low strip (length ~3.6) with number tiles (3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24) as small flat plates. Marker: an amber arrow that hops tile-to-tile as the learner steps it. Times-table strip: a narrower plate beneath with '3 × 1 = 3'...'3 × 8 = 24' rows. Slider: a small rail at the front that changes the base number (e.g. to 4 or 5) and rebuilds the tiles by skip counting. A Common-Multiple layer adds a second ghost list and glows any shared number (e.g. 12 for bases 3 and 4).

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) base track; (2) times-table strip; (3) second list + common-multiple highlight.

CAMERA: head-on from +z frames the track and strip; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: Track, NumberTiles, Marker, TimesTableStrip, Slider_Knob, GhostList, CommonGlow. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
